Consistency uses at least five available.en: Consistency uses at least five available values from the same club and camera angle.
Consistency uses at least five available.ko: 일관성은 같은 클럽과 촬영 각도에서 얻은 사용 가능한 측정값이 최소 5개일 때 계산합니다.
Consistency uses at least five available.ja: 一貫性は、同じクラブと撮影アングルで得られた有効な測定値が5件以上ある場合に計算します。
Consistency uses at least five available.zh-Hans: 一致性计算至少需要同一球杆和拍摄角度下的五个有效测量值。
Consistency uses at least five available.zh-Hant: 一致性計算至少需要同一球桿和拍攝角度下的五個有效測量值。
Consistency uses at least five available.es: La consistencia se calcula con al menos cinco valores disponibles del mismo palo y ángulo de cámara.
Consistency uses at least five available.pt-BR: A consistência usa pelo menos cinco valores disponíveis do mesmo taco e ângulo de câmera.
Consistency uses at least five available.de: Die Konstanz wird aus mindestens fünf verfügbaren Werten mit demselben Schläger und Kamerawinkel berechnet.
Consistency uses at least five available.fr: La régularité utilise au moins cinq valeurs disponibles avec le même club et le même angle de caméra.
Consistency uses at least five available.it: La regolarità usa almeno cinque valori disponibili con lo stesso bastone e la stessa angolazione della fotocamera.
Consistency uses at least five available.th: การคำนวณความสม่ำเสมอใช้ค่าที่มีอย่างน้อยห้าค่าจากไม้และมุมกล้องเดียวกัน
Consistency uses at least five available.vi: Độ ổn định được tính từ ít nhất năm giá trị có sẵn của cùng gậy và góc quay.

Session details describe the practice. I.zh-Hans: 练习详情用于描述本次练习。各录像的标签保持原样。

Same camera angle and club, up to 20 ear.en: Same camera angle and club, up to 20 earlier analyzed swings. Observations, not faults.
Same camera angle and club, up to 20 ear.ko: 같은 촬영 각도와 클럽으로 이전에 분석한 스윙을 최대 20개까지 비교합니다. 관찰 결과이며 결함 진단이 아닙니다.
Same camera angle and club, up to 20 ear.ja: 同じ撮影アングルとクラブの、以前に分析した最大20スイングと比較します。観察結果であり、欠点の診断ではありません。
Same camera angle and club, up to 20 ear.zh-Hans: 比较同一拍摄角度和球杆下先前分析的最多20次挥杆。仅提供观察结果，不诊断挥杆缺陷。
Same camera angle and club, up to 20 ear.zh-Hant: 比較同一拍攝角度和球桿下先前分析的最多20次揮桿。僅提供觀察結果，不診斷揮桿缺陷。
Same camera angle and club, up to 20 ear.es: Mismo ángulo de cámara y palo, hasta 20 swings analizados anteriormente. Son observaciones, no fallos.
Same camera angle and club, up to 20 ear.pt-BR: Mesmo ângulo de câmera e taco, até 20 swings analisados anteriormente. São observações, não defeitos.
Same camera angle and club, up to 20 ear.de: Gleicher Kamerawinkel und Schläger, bis zu 20 zuvor analysierte Schwünge. Beobachtungen, keine Fehlerdiagnosen.
Same camera angle and club, up to 20 ear.fr: Même angle de caméra et même club, jusqu’à 20 swings analysés auparavant. Des observations, pas des défauts.
Same camera angle and club, up to 20 ear.it: Stesso bastone e angolazione della fotocamera, fino a 20 swing analizzati in precedenza. Osservazioni, non diagnosi di difetti.
Same camera angle and club, up to 20 ear.th: เปรียบเทียบกับสวิงที่วิเคราะห์ก่อนหน้านี้สูงสุด 20 ครั้งจากมุมกล้องและไม้เดียวกัน เป็นข้อสังเกต ไม่ใช่การวินิจฉัยข้อผิดพลาด
Same camera angle and club, up to 20 ear.vi: Cùng góc quay và gậy, tối đa 20 cú swing đã phân tích trước đó. Đây là nhận xét, không phải chẩn đoán lỗi.
